positive_prompt:
COUNT LOCK — THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT RULE: the LAST image provided is the guest photo. Count the people in it. The output must contain EXACTLY that many people — not one more, not one fewer. One person in the photo means one person alone in the output. Three people means exactly those three. Five means exactly those five. You are FORBIDDEN from inventing, adding, duplicating, cloning, mirroring or imagining any person who is not in that photo. Do not add anyone to balance the composition, fill empty space, fill the frame width, or make the group look bigger. If the people do not fill the frame, leave the remaining space to the environment — empty space is correct and expected. The command centre behind and beside them is completely empty of other people — no colleagues, no bystanders, no faces in the distance.

IDENTITY LOCK: use the faces, identities and appearance of the subject or subjects in the provided photo. Keep each one exactly as they appear — same pose, same position, same gesture, same left-to-right order. Each keeps their own exact facial features, face shape, skin tone and undertone, ethnicity, hairstyle, hairline, hair length and hair colour, facial hair, body size and build, and every personal accessory (prescription glasses, headscarf, watch, jewellery). Do not blend, swap, average or beautify any face. Do not lighten or whiten any skin tone. Do not slim, widen or reshape any body. Do not make anyone look younger or older. Do not change anyone's gender. Every face stays fully visible and unobstructed — nothing covers anyone's eyes, nose or mouth. Each looks toward the camera with a natural, confident, closed-mouth smile.

WARDROBE — INTENTIONALLY CHANGED: ignore the clothing worn in the provided photo and dress everyone in sharp formal business attire — a dark tailored blazer over a crisp white shirt, consistent across the group. Anyone wearing a headscarf keeps it, in plain dark navy to match, with long sleeves. Anyone wearing prescription glasses keeps them.

BRAND MARK: the FIRST image provided is the Garudafood corporate logo — a blue eagle head facing right with a gold beak and a blue leaf sprig below it, beside the bold blue "Garudafood" wordmark. Reproduce it accurately, keeping the blue and gold colours and the eagle shape intact. It appears small and neat on the left chest of every blazer, roughly palm-sized, and again as a premium three-dimensional signage piece on the wall behind them — the eagle and wordmark cut as thick polished acrylic letters standing proud off the wall surface, rendered in the exact Garudafood blue and gold, catching a soft specular highlight along their raised edges, casting a clean contact shadow onto the wall. Behind the letters, a concealed backlight throws a soft halo of that same blue onto the wall, glowing outward and fading off — a low-opacity coloured bloom around the sign, subtle and expensive-looking, never a harsh glare and never washing out the letters themselves.

PRODUCTS — COPY, DO NOT INVENT: the SECOND image provided is a product sheet of real Garudafood retail packs laid out on a plain background. Every product that appears in the scene must be copied directly from that sheet — same pack shapes, same brand artwork, same logos, same colours, same proportions, reproduced faithfully as real printed packaging. Pick a handful of packs from that sheet and place them naturally in the scene at a believable physical size. One of the dashboard panels on the wall behind displays a clean product lineup still-life of these packs as a portfolio performance view, and two or three of the packs stand neatly on the polished table in the foreground. Keep the product placement tasteful and uncluttered — a considered brand detail in the environment, never a pile of packs and never blocking anyone's face or body. You are FORBIDDEN from designing, inventing, substituting or improvising any snack packaging, and from using any brand that does not appear on that sheet. Generic, blank, unbranded or made-up packs are wrong. The printed brand names on these packs (Gery, Garuda, Chocolatos, Okky, Mountea, Prochiz, Dilan, Clevo, Nusalera, Leo, Ting Ting) must render as legible packaging text exactly as shown on the sheet.

SCENE: standing in a modern finance command centre. A large wall of financial dashboards glows behind, showing revenue, cost, profit and cash-flow charts as clean abstract bar columns and line curves. Dark, premium, executive environment with polished surfaces.

FRAMING: photographed by a photographer standing in front of the group at natural standing eye level, straight-on, horizon level. Not a selfie, no arm reaching toward the lens, no wide-angle distortion. Waist-up to mid-thigh crop — legs, knees, feet and shoes are not visible. Keep the exact same number of people, in the same left-to-right order and the same relative positions as the guest photo — do not spread them out to fill the frame and do not add anyone beside or behind them. Bodies angled at a relaxed three-quarter turn of about 20 degrees, faces turned directly to the lens. Every face sharp and individually recognisable.

LIGHTING: dramatic low-key executive lighting — the wall of dashboards casting a deep cool blue glow across the dark room, a warm neutral key light sculpting every face bright and clean, and a sharp cyan rim light edging shoulders and hair. Rich cinematic contrast, faces never dark, no blue cast on skin.

CAMERA: ARRI Alexa 35, Zeiss Supreme Prime 40mm, f/2.0. Everyone tack sharp with a clear depth separation — the dashboards and command centre behind rendering into soft creamy bokeh, background practical lights blooming into gentle round highlights. Subtle atmospheric haze in the air catching the light, giving the room real depth. Fine natural film grain, slight highlight roll-off, gentle anamorphic-style falloff at the frame edges. Realistic skin texture with visible pores, natural shine and subtle imperfections, no plastic smoothing.

GRADE: rich cinematic colour grading with deep controlled contrast — lifted filmic blacks, warm highlights, clean natural skin tones held perfectly neutral against the environment's colour. Premium FMCG brand campaign quality, the polish of a national television commercial. High resolution.

DO NOT: add, duplicate or invent any person; blend, swap, average or beautify any face; lighten or smooth any skin; slim or reshape any body; cover any face with a mask, goggles, hairnet, cap or hand; use a selfie angle, fisheye or tilted horizon; show feet, shoes or a full-body view; render any invented text, slogan, price tag or signage wording — the only legible text allowed is the Garudafood wordmark and the real brand names printed on the product packs copied from the product sheet; add a watermark; flat even lighting, dull flat grading, stock photo look, oversaturate, add HDR halos, harsh shadows or dark faces. NEVER add a person who is not in the guest photo — no extra colleague, no background figure, no duplicate of anyone, no reflection of a person; the people count must match the guest photo exactly.
video_positive_prompt:
Locked-off static camera on a tripod. The camera does not move at all - no push-in, no zoom, no pan, no tilt, no dolly, no tracking, no handheld drift. The framing stays completely fixed for the entire shot.

PEOPLE LOCK: exactly the same people as in the still image, and nobody else. No one enters the frame, no one walks in from the side or from behind, no new face appears, no extra hand, arm or body comes in from off-screen, no person in any reflection. Everyone stays in the same position, the same pose and the same left-to-right order for the whole shot. Nobody is added, duplicated or removed.

PRODUCT LOCK: every pack, package, bowl, tablet, folder or object stays EXACTLY the object it already is in the still image - identical shape, identical brand artwork, identical logo, identical colours, identical printed label text, identical size. Do not redesign, re-label, recolour, morph, swap or replace it, and never turn it into a different product or a different brand. Do not add any product, pack or object that is not already visible in the still image - if nobody is holding anything, then nobody starts holding anything and no new item appears in any hand or anywhere in the scene.

ACTION - only if a product is ALREADY in someone's hand in the still image: that same person tilts that same pack very slightly, just a few degrees, so its front face reads a little more clearly to the lens, then holds still again. The hand does not travel, does not lift toward the camera, does not extend, offer, hand over or pass it to anyone. If no product is in anyone's hand, nothing is tilted and every hand stays completely still.

MOTION: micro-movements only - natural eye blinks, gentle breathing, a small settle of the shoulders, a slight head movement, and a warm closed-mouth smile that grows naturally. No walking, no stepping, no turning around, no big arm gestures, no reaching toward the lens. Apart from that one small tilt, every hand stays exactly where it is. Mouths stay closed - nobody talks.

Ambient cyan and deep blue dashboard glow softly reflecting on polished surfaces, calm executive composure, filmic contrast.
